column1: Score each lead 0-100 on Fit, Intent and Quality. The grade is set by the LOWEST band any score falls into. Work Grade A first, top-down.

Grade thresholds: A = Fit>=65 & Intent>=60 & Quality>=60 | B = Fit>=55 & Intent>=40 & Quality>=50 | C = Fit>=40 & Intent>=25 & Quality>=35 | D = Fit>=20 & Intent>=10 & Quality>=20 | F = Quality<20 (junk)

Fit = how well the lead matches your ICP (industry, geography, business type, role, budget). Intent = live engagement (call, WhatsApp reply, meeting) minus decay when silent. Quality = data reliability (valid phone, email, company, clear inquiry).
Tip: recompute Intent as new signals arrive; drop it ~3 points/day when a lead goes silent so stale Grade A leads fall to B/C on their own.
